comparison.objective: Hold a nail upright while another arm hammers it into a post.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual/multi-arm fixturing, timing, withdrawal, and collision avoidance around an impact tool.
comparison.success_condition: Nail driven sufficiently while avoiding arm–arm and hammer–helper contact.
comparison.reason: This is dynamic cooperative fixturing during hammering, not a supported rail transfer or rolling-element preservation task.
